comments.body:
Hey buddy, first of all, nothing is wrong with you! The housing market in Zürich is just completely fucked and it makes it insanely hard to find a WG Room! Maybe I could help you depending on how much you‘re willing to pay for a WG room… I‘m managing a 6-Person WG at the moment myself and 1 Person is Moving out at the end of August. I haven‘t advertised the room yet, so incase you‘re interested just hit me up with a dm and I can give you more details! I‘m 23 years old and studying interdisciplinary Sciences (PCN) at the moment in my first year (but sadly the second try🥲)… all the others living here are also ETH students! 
Wish you all the best of luck on finding a suitable WG room, it may help as well to take a look outside of Zürich
comments.author: TheDutchCardist
